An '''assassin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> he, along with [[Unidentified Human assassin (Garik Loran)|two]] [[Unidentified Sullustan assassin|other]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], [[Attempted assassination on Garik Loran|tried]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Wraith Squadron]] leader [[Garik Loran]] at a [[Unidentified Coruscant pedestrian market|pedestrian market]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. However, Loran killed him instead.<ref name="MK" />
